mcqs.stem: Best guess: a company changed its inventory method, applied it properly, and disclosed it. What does the auditor's report include?

choices.text: A qualified opinion for the change in principle
choices.explanation: A properly accounted-for change doesn't modify the opinion.

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph about the change
choices.explanation: The matter is in the statements, so it's emphasis of matter.

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph on the disclosure
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 708 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph for a change in principle with a material effect.

choices.text: Nothing beyond the standard unmodified report

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 708 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph for a change in principle with a material effect.

mcqs.stem: Which matter belongs in an **other-matter** paragraph?

choices.text: A significant subsequent event that is disclosed in the notes
choices.explanation: That's disclosed in the statements — emphasis of matter.

choices.text: A major catastrophe that is disclosed in the notes
A properly applied change in accounting principle
Prior-year statements audited by a predecessor, report not shown
choices.explanation: Correct. Other-matter paragraphs address matters not presented or disclosed in the statements.

mcqs.explanation: Other-matter paragraphs address matters not presented or disclosed in the statements.

mcqs.stem: Which best describes a critical audit matter under PCAOB AS 3101?

choices.text: A matter sent to the audit committee involving especially challenging judgment
choices.explanation: Correct. AS 3101 defines CAMs using all three elements.

choices.text: Any matter discussed with management during the audit
choices.explanation: CAMs come from matters communicated to the audit committee.

choices.text: Any matter that requires a qualified opinion on the statements
Any control deficiency identified during the audit

mcqs.explanation: AS 3101 defines CAMs using all three elements.

mcqs.stem: A company changed the estimated useful life of its equipment. What should the auditor's report include?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Estimate changes don't affect consistency reporting.

choices.text: A qualified opinion
choices.explanation: A properly accounted-for estimate change isn't a departure.

choices.text: No additional paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. Changes in accounting estimates don't require a consistency paragraph.

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: An estimate change doesn't call for an other-matter paragraph.

mcqs.explanation: Changes in accounting estimates don't require a consistency paragraph.

mcqs.stem: What statement accompanies an emphasis-of-matter paragraph?

choices.text: "Our opinion is qualified in this respect."
"The statements do not present fairly in this respect."
"We do not express an opinion on this matter."
"Our opinion is not modified with respect to this matter."
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 706: the paragraph indicates the opinion isn't modified with respect to the matter.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 706: the paragraph indicates the opinion isn't modified with respect to the matter.

mcqs.stem: A company corrected a material misstatement in previously issued statements. What does the auditor's current report include?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 708 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph for correction of a material misstatement in previously issued statements.

choices.text: Nothing beyond the standard report
choices.explanation: Correction of an error requires a paragraph.

choices.text: An adverse opinion on the prior year
choices.explanation: The corrected statements are fairly presented.

choices.text: A disclaimer on the restated year

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 708 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph for correction of a material misstatement in previously issued statements.

mcqs.stem: For a nonissuer audit, when are key audit matters communicated in the auditor's report?

choices.text: Always, in every nonissuer audit report
choices.explanation: KAMs are reported only when the auditor is engaged to do so.

choices.text: Only when the opinion is qualified or adverse
When the auditor is engaged to communicate them
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 701 applies when the auditor is engaged (or required by law) to communicate KAMs.

choices.text: Never; KAMs apply only to issuer audits
choices.explanation: They can be reported if engaged.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 701 applies when the auditor is engaged (or required by law) to communicate KAMs.

mcqs.stem: The annual report includes a CEO letter claiming revenue grew 20%; the audited statements show 5%. The CEO refuses to correct it. What should the auditor do?

choices.text: Nothing, because the auditor doesn't audit other information
choices.explanation: The auditor must consider material inconsistencies.

choices.text: Correct the CEO letter directly before the report is issued
choices.explanation: The auditor doesn't alter management's documents.

choices.text: Issue an adverse opinion on the audited financial statements
Describe the uncorrected misstatement in the Other Information section
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 720: if other information is materially misstated and not corrected, the auditor includes a statement in the Other Information section, or takes other action.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 720: if other information is materially misstated and not corrected, the auditor includes a statement in the Other Information section, or takes other action.

mcqs.stem: Which of the following requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph in a report on statements prepared under a special purpose framework?

choices.text: Alerting readers that the statements use a basis other than GAAP
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800: an emphasis-of-matter paragraph alerts users to the special purpose framework.

choices.text: Stating the audit fee and the auditor's relationship to the client
Listing the members of the engagement team
Describing the auditor's sampling methods and results

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 800: an emphasis-of-matter paragraph alerts users to the special purpose framework.

mcqs.stem: A CAM is identified for the valuation of goodwill. What must the auditor's report describe for it?

choices.text: Only that the matter exists and was discussed
Why it is a CAM, how it was addressed, and the related accounts
choices.explanation: Correct. AS 3101: identify the CAM, describe why, how it was addressed, and refer to the relevant accounts or disclosures.

choices.text: A separate opinion on the goodwill balance
Management's impairment calculations in full

mcqs.explanation: AS 3101: identify the CAM, describe why, how it was addressed, and refer to the relevant accounts or disclosures.

mcqs.stem: Can a key audit matter be used instead of a qualified opinion?

choices.text: Yes, if the matter is fully described in the KAM section
choices.explanation: KAMs aren't a substitute for modifications.

choices.text: No; KAMs never substitute for a modified opinion
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 701 and AS 3101 both prohibit using KAMs/CAMs in place of required modifications.

choices.text: Yes, but only in audits of nonissuers
choices.explanation: Substitution isn't permitted for any entity.

choices.text: Only when the client agrees to the substitution
choices.explanation: Client agreement doesn't change the rule.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 701 and AS 3101 both prohibit using KAMs/CAMs in place of required modifications.

mcqs.stem: The auditor is engaged to report on supplementary information accompanying the audited statements. What opinion is given on it?

choices.text: A separate opinion on the fair presentation of the information
choices.explanation: It's reported on "in relation to" the statements.

choices.text: Whether it is fairly stated in relation to the statements
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 725: the auditor reports whether supplementary information is fairly stated in relation to the statements as a whole.

choices.text: No opinion is ever given on supplementary information
A review conclusion with limited assurance
choices.explanation: This is an audit engagement, not a review.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 725: the auditor reports whether supplementary information is fairly stated in relation to the statements as a whole.

mcqs.stem: A company changed an accounting principle without reasonable justification. What is the effect on the report?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph only, with no modification
choices.explanation: An unjustified change is a GAAP departure.

choices.text: A qualified or adverse opinion, by pervasiveness
choices.explanation: Correct. A change not properly justified or accounted for is a departure from the framework → modified opinion.

choices.text: A disclaimer of opinion for the change
No effect if the change is disclosed

mcqs.explanation: A change not properly justified or accounted for is a departure from the framework → modified opinion.

mcqs.stem: A client made a justified change in accounting principle with a material effect. What does a nonissuer report include?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 708 requires one for a justified change in principle.

choices.text: A qualified opinion on the statements
choices.explanation: A justified change isn't a misstatement.

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph only
choices.explanation: The matter is in the statements.

choices.text: No mention of the change at all

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 708.08: include an emphasis-of-matter paragraph when there is a justified change in principle that has a material effect.

mcqs.stem: A company restated prior-year statements to correct a material misstatement, and the correction is properly disclosed. What does the current report include?

choices.text: An adverse opinion on the current year
An emphasis-of-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. Corrections of material misstatements are highlighted for consistency.

choices.text: Nothing, because it has been corrected
A disclaimer on the prior-year statements

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 708.13: when there is an adjustment to correct a material misstatement in previously issued statements, include an emphasis-of-matter paragraph.

mcqs.stem: The annual report's CEO letter materially misstates revenue growth compared with the audited statements, and management refuses to correct it. What should the auditor do?

choices.text: Modify the opinion on the statements
Ignore it, because it is unaudited
Describe it in the report
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 720 requires describing an uncorrected material misstatement of other information.

choices.text: Correct the CEO letter directly

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 720: if an uncorrected material misstatement of the other information exists, the auditor describes it in the report's other information section and considers further actions.

mcqs.stem: How does the auditor report on supplementary information accompanying audited statements?

choices.text: With a separate, full audit opinion
With no reporting on it at all
With a review-level conclusion
In relation to the statements
choices.explanation: Correct. The opinion is whether it is fairly stated in relation to them.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 725: the auditor reports whether supplementary information is fairly stated, in all material respects, in relation to the statements as a whole.

mcqs.stem: Statements are prepared under a contractual basis intended only for a lender. What does the report include?

choices.text: A restriction on its use
choices.explanation: Correct. Use is restricted to the specified parties.

choices.text: An adverse opinion
A general-use statement
A going-concern section

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 800: reports on contractual-basis statements include an other-matter paragraph restricting use.

mcqs.stem: A government omits required supplementary information (RSI). How does the auditor's report address it?

choices.text: With a qualified opinion
choices.explanation: RSI isn't part of the statements.

choices.text: With an adverse opinion
choices.explanation: RSI isn't part of the statements.

choices.text: Not at all; RSI is optional
In an other-matter paragraph

mcqs.explanation: When required supplementary information is omitted, the auditor reports it in an other-matter paragraph without modifying the opinion.

mcqs.stem: A major hurricane destroyed a client's main plant after year-end, and it's properly disclosed. What may the auditor add?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. A major catastrophe may be emphasized.

choices.text: A qualified opinion on the statements
An other-matter paragraph only
choices.explanation: The matter is disclosed in the statements.

choices.text: A disclaimer of opinion

mcqs.explanation: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph may highlight a properly disclosed major catastrophe.

mcqs.stem: Prior-year comparative statements weren't audited. How does the current report address them?

choices.text: A qualified prior-year opinion
An other-matter paragraph
No reference to them at all
A current-year disclaimer

mcqs.explanation: If prior-period statements weren't audited, the auditor states so in an other-matter paragraph.

mcqs.stem: Part of the annual report will be available only after the report date. What is the auditor's responsibility?

choices.text: Nothing, after the report date
Delay the report until it's ready
Read it when available
choices.explanation: Correct. And respond to any material inconsistency.

choices.text: Audit it fully

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 720: other information obtained after the report date is read when available, and material inconsistencies are addressed.

mcqs.stem: Supplementary information is materially misstated, and management won't correct it. What should the auditor do?

choices.text: Qualify the statements' opinion
Ignore it as unaudited
Issue an adverse opinion
Modify the opinion on it
choices.explanation: Correct. Or withhold the report on it.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 725: if supplementary information is materially misstated, the auditor modifies the opinion on it or withholds the report.

mcqs.stem: What does an emphasis-of-matter paragraph refer to?

choices.text: A matter not in the statements
A material misstatement
A matter already disclosed
A scope limitation

mcqs.explanation: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph draws attention to a matter appropriately presented or disclosed that is fundamental to understanding.

mcqs.stem: What does an other-matter paragraph refer to?

choices.text: A disclosed fundamental matter
A material misstatement
Management's responsibilities
Matters not in the statements
choices.explanation: Correct. It's relevant to understanding the audit.

mcqs.explanation: An other-matter paragraph refers to matters not presented or disclosed that are relevant to users' understanding of the audit or report.

mcqs.stem: Under PCAOB standards, what are matters communicated to the audit committee that involve especially challenging judgment called?

choices.text: Critical audit matters
choices.explanation: Correct. CAMs relate to material accounts.

choices.text: Key engagement findings
Emphasis-of-matter items
Other-matter paragraphs

mcqs.explanation: CAMs arise from matters communicated to the audit committee that relate to material accounts or disclosures and involve especially challenging judgment.

mcqs.stem: A nonissuer properly adopts and discloses a change in accounting principle with a material effect. What does the report include?

choices.text: A qualified opinion
An emphasis paragraph
An other-matter paragraph
Nothing extra in the report

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 708 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph for a justified change in principle with a material effect.

mcqs.stem: The prior year was audited by a predecessor whose report isn't reissued. How is this addressed?

choices.text: An emphasis paragraph
A qualified opinion
An other-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. It describes the predecessor's report.

choices.text: No mention

mcqs.explanation: The successor's report includes an other-matter paragraph describing the predecessor's report on the prior year.

mcqs.stem: A major fire after year-end is properly disclosed, and the auditor wants users to notice it. What report is appropriate?

choices.text: Qualified, with emphasis added
An adverse opinion
A disclaimer of opinion
Unmodified, with emphasis

mcqs.explanation: An adequately disclosed matter may be emphasized without modifying the opinion.

mcqs.stem: The annual report's other information is materially inconsistent with the audited statements, and management won't fix it. What should the auditor do?

choices.text: Describe it in the report
Ignore it as outside the audit
Qualify the opinion
Issue an adverse opinion

mcqs.explanation: An uncorrected material misstatement of other information is described in the other information section; the opinion isn't modified.

mcqs.stem: A company adopted a new accounting standard with a material effect, applied properly. How should the auditor report?

choices.text: Qualified opinion for the change
choices.explanation: A properly applied change isn't a departure.

choices.text: Adverse opinion on the statements
Unmodified, with an other-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: The matter is in the statements.

choices.text: Unmodified, with an emphasis paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 708: a change in principle with a material effect → emphasis of matter.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 708: a change in principle with a material effect → emphasis of matter.

mcqs.stem: Which matter is appropriately communicated in an other-matter paragraph?

choices.text: A restriction on the use of the auditor's report
choices.explanation: Correct. Other-matter paragraphs address matters not in the statements, such as use restrictions.

choices.text: A major lawsuit disclosed in Note 8
choices.explanation: That's in the statements — emphasis of matter.

choices.text: A change in accounting principle
choices.explanation: That calls for emphasis of matter.

choices.text: Substantial doubt about going concern

mcqs.explanation: Other-matter paragraphs address matters not in the statements, such as use restrictions.

mcqs.stem: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph is used to draw users' attention to a matter that is:

choices.text: Properly disclosed and fundamental to understanding
choices.explanation: Correct. It highlights a matter already properly in the statements without modifying the opinion.

choices.text: Misstated in the statements and requires a qualified opinion
choices.explanation: Misstatements require a modified opinion, not emphasis.

choices.text: Relevant to the audit but not presented in the statements
A limitation on the scope of the audit
choices.explanation: Scope limitations lead to modified opinions.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 706: an emphasis-of-matter paragraph refers to a matter appropriately presented or disclosed that, in the auditor's judgment, is fundamental to users' understanding.

mcqs.stem: Which matter is most likely communicated in an other-matter paragraph?

choices.text: A significant uncertainty disclosed in the notes
choices.explanation: That is typically an emphasis-of-matter paragraph.

choices.text: A material misstatement management refused to correct
A predecessor audited the prior-year statements
choices.explanation: Correct. Other-matter paragraphs address matters relevant to the audit or report not presented in the statements.

choices.text: A change in accounting principle disclosed in the notes
choices.explanation: A justified change is noted with an emphasis-of-matter paragraph.

mcqs.explanation: AU-C 706: other-matter paragraphs refer to matters not presented or disclosed in the statements that are relevant to users' understanding of the audit or report.

flashcards.back: EOM: matter disclosed in the statements. OM: matter not in the statements (about the audit or report).
Change in principle (material) and correction of a material misstatement → EOM.
Communicated to the audit committee; relates to material accounts or disclosures; especially challenging, subjective, or complex judgment.
Fairly stated in relation to the statements as a whole.
